explication: DAC turns YAML or TSX dashboard definitions into validated dashboards, resolves widget queries, and serves interactive dashboards through a Go API and React UI. Users can also validate/query projects, manage connections, export dashboards, and import Metabase content. The README documents semantic metrics and dimensions, TSX-driven layouts, multiple database providers through Bruin, and static output. Several subsystems are represented from the README or source index rather than inspected implementation; edges are limited to relationships visible in excerpts or documented there.
